articles.description: Pakistan achieved an unwanted Test record by losing their opening wicket for zero runs in both innings. This rare feat occurred for the seventh time in their Test match history. England's bowlers dominated the match, securing an innings victory inside three days. Ollie Robinson and Josh Tongue were instrumental in Pakistan's batting collapses. The result gave England a lead in the ongoing three-match series.

After a 1962 storm battered Fire Island, Robert Moses proposed a highway along the New York barrier
articles.description: The fierce nor'easter of 1962 became a pivotal moment for Robert Moses as he sought to introduce a highway on Fire Island. Yet, the local populace and property owners stood firm against the initiative, worried for their environment and community’s future. Their activism prompted valuable support from the federal government, leading to the creation of Fire Island National Seashore in 1964, which has preserved the island's unspoiled setting.

articles.title: People gather together for Jimmy Cricket’s funeral procession
articles.description: A heartfelt farewell unfolded as thousands of fans and family members flocked to comedian Jimmy Cricket's funeral procession. Attendees donned bow ties and elements of his memorable stage costume as a tribute. The requiem Mass was led by his son, Fr. Frankiel Mulgrew, at Salford Cathedral, with many fellow artists present to honor the cherished entertainer, who passed away at the age of eighty earlier this month.

articles.title: ‘Batwara 1947’ Day 8 Drop: India net slips to ₹75 lakh; worldwide gross nears ₹49.02cr
articles.description: Batwara 1947 faced a significant box office slump on its second Friday, reporting earnings of less than one crore rupees for its eighth day. With worldwide gross nearing fifty crore, the film now transitions into its second weekend. The Indian net collection on day eight was around seventy-five lakhs, marking a steep decline of forty-four percent from the prior day.

articles.title: 'Khalifa' BO day 2: Prithviraj Sukumaran starrer earns Rs 2.30 crore
articles.description: Prithviraj Sukumaran's film Khalifa experienced a steep domestic earnings decline on its second day. The movie's India net collection dropped fifty-seven percent from its opening day figure. Overseas markets continued to contribute strongly to the film's overall earnings. Khalifa recorded an overall occupancy of thirty-two percent across its Malayalam 2D shows. The film's combined domestic and international earnings reached nineteen point nine zero crore rupees.

articles.title: 'Toxic' advance booking nears Rs 20 crore presales
articles.description: Yash's film 'Toxic' shows strong advance booking numbers for its upcoming release. The Kannada version leads the advance sales, contributing significantly to the total. Karnataka is the top region for advance bookings, reflecting the actor's home market. International markets like the USA are also showing interest in the film. The movie has received an 'A' certificate in India and an 18 rating in the UK.
